title: Sponsor Finance Terms Sheet: PBM Services Agreement Invoicing, Payment and Dispute Terms
content:
For plan sponsor finance staff: the PBM Services Agreement sets the claims invoicing cycle, the payment terms, the late payment interest and its grace period, the claims funding deposit, and the time limits for disputing an invoice. The figures below apply according to the sponsor's pricing arrangement.

## Claims invoicing and payment

| Pricing arrangement | Claims invoicing cycle | Payment terms (calendar days after invoice date) | Claims funding deposit (weeks of average claims cost) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | weekly | 10 | 2 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | weekly | 10 | 2 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | weekly | 10 | 2 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | biweekly | 15 | 1 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | biweekly | 15 | 1 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | biweekly | 15 | 0 (none) |

A deposit figure of 0 means no claims funding deposit is held.

## Late payment interest

The interest rate is stated per month and applies to an invoice amount left unpaid past the grace period; the grace period is counted in calendar days after the due date.

| Pricing arrangement | Late payment interest (per month) | Grace period (calendar days after due date) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 1.5% | 5 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 1.5% | 5 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 1.25% | 5 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 1% | 5 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 1% | 5 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 1% | 5 |

## Invoice disputes

The dispute window is the number of calendar days after the invoice date within which an invoice may be disputed; the resolution period is the number of calendar days within which a timely dispute is resolved.

| Pricing arrangement | Dispute window (calendar days after invoice date) | Dispute resolution (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 30 | 30 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 30 | 30 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 45 | 30 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 45 | 30 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 60 | 30 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 60 | 30 |

## Summary by group of arrangements

- Northbridge Traditional Pricing, Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing and Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus are invoiced weekly with 10-day payment terms and a 2-week deposit.
- Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus, Northbridge Enterprise Value and Northbridge Coalition Purchasing are invoiced biweekly with 15-day payment terms; their deposits are 1, 1 and 0 weeks.
- The grace period (5 calendar days) and the dispute resolution period (30 calendar days) are the same for all six arrangements.
